entries.t:
This screen gathers everything you need
to play Card Robattle.
Jump into the world of Card Robattle
from here!

Spend the coins you win in Robattles
to buy packs!
Packs contain Support Medabot cards,
Tactics cards and Medafighter cards.

Leader Medabot and Part cards are won
by beating rivals in Robattle Challenge
and Robattle Tower.

A mode where you battle rivals waiting
in all kinds of terrain.
Leaders have leg types and gain an edge
on terrain they favor.

If you keep losing, pick a Leader to
suit the opponent and the terrain.

A mode where you climb the tower
fighting random opponents.
It gives lots of coins, so climb, buy
packs and get new cards.

Complete your deck by picking cards
from several categories.

You can hold up to 3 copies of a card.
Cards below that limit can be created
by spending Dust.

Some cards are created with Tickets,
earned by battling other players.

You can spend coins to modify a
Leader's starting part (left arm).
Modifying turns it into a part of the
same name with different stats.

Medals gain EXP from battles and level up.
Leveling up improves Medaforce power
and can grant new Medaforces.
